name: Hollybank Bakery (example)
greeting: Hi! Ask me a question, or tap one below.
fallback: Sorry, I don't have an answer for that one, so I won't guess. Email [hello@example-bakery.co.uk](mailto:hello@example-bakery.co.uk) and we'll reply.

faqs.a: We're open Tuesday to Saturday, 8am to 4pm. We're closed Sunday and Monday.
Yes. Celebration cakes need 5 days' notice. Use the [order form](/order) or email hello@example-bakery.co.uk.
We bake a gluten-free loaf and brownies every Friday. Our kitchen uses flour, so we can't promise they're safe for coeliacs.
We deliver cake orders within 5 miles for £5. Bread and pastries are collection only.
There's free on-street parking on Market Lane after 9:30am, and a pay car park behind the church.
Yes, we take card and contactless. We don't take cheques.
Our sourdough, focaccia and fruit buns are vegan. Ask at the counter for today's vegan cake.
Yes. Message us by 6pm the day before and we'll keep it until 12pm.

faqs.q: Do you do wholesale for cafés?
faqs.a: Yes, for cafés within 10 miles. Email hello@example-bakery.co.uk with what you need and how often.
If something isn't right, bring it back the same day with your receipt and we'll replace it or refund you.
